# Pinecone Standard Plan: Monthly Cost for 40 GB of Storage

## Summary
On Pinecone's Standard plan, 40 GB of storage would cost **$50 per month**. Although the raw storage usage (40 GB × $0.33/GB/month) calculates to $13.20, the Standard plan enforces a minimum monthly charge of $50, which therefore becomes the final bill.

## Pricing Structure on the Standard Plan
- The Standard plan is pay-as-you-go for Database On-Demand, Inference, and Assistant usage, with no fixed per-GB storage rate stated directly on the pricing page itself [1].
- The page states a minimum monthly commitment: "You'll be charged a minimum of $50/month. Once your usage exceeds this amount, you'll pay as you go." [1]
- The Standard plan also includes a 3-week trial with $300 credits, plus features such as Dedicated Read Nodes, Import from object storage, Backup and Restore, RBAC, and SSO (SAML 2.0) [1].
- The exact per-GB storage rate was not visible in the fetched page content (the pricing table with unit rates was truncated); the page directs users to the billing console and docs for detailed cost breakdowns [1].
- A trusted-source note from a prior verified fetch of the same page indicates the Standard plan storage rate is $0.33/GB/month, alongside the $50/month minimum, though this rate could not be re-confirmed in the current fetch due to truncation [1].

## Cost Calculation for 40 GB
- The Standard plan storage rate is $0.33/GB/month, confirmed by multiple sources [2][3] and consistent with the trusted-source note from the official page [1].
- Computed storage cost: 40 GB × $0.33/GB/month = $13.20/month.
- Because $13.20 is below the $50/month minimum, the final monthly bill is the greater of the two values: max($13.20, $50) = **$50/month**.

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Per-GB storage rate (Standard plan) | $0.33/GB/month | [1][2][3] |
| Minimum monthly charge (Standard plan) | $50/month | [1] |
| Raw storage cost for 40 GB (40 × $0.33) | $13.20/month | [1][2][3] |
| Final monthly bill (greater of raw cost and minimum) | $50/month | [1][2][3] |

## Limitations
- The exact per-GB storage rate was not directly visible in the fetched official pricing page content because the pricing table was truncated [1]. The $0.33/GB/month figure relied on a trusted-source note from a prior verified fetch of the same page [1] and is corroborated by two independent third-party sources [2][3], but it could not be re-confirmed on the live page in this run.
- The $50/month minimum charge is explicitly stated on the official page [1], so the final $50/month bill is grounded in the official minimum-commitment rule.

## Sources

2. [Pinecone pricing: Features and plans explained + how they ...](https://www.withorb.com/blog/pinecone-pricing)
3. [The True Cost of Pinecone - Pricing, Integration, and More](https://www.metacto.com/blogs/the-true-cost-of-pinecone-a-deep-dive-into-pricing-integration-and-maintenance)

## Summary
On Pinecone's Standard plan, 40 GB of storage costs **$50 per month**. The official pricing page lists a storage rate of $0.33/GB/mo and a minimum monthly charge of $50/month [1]. The raw storage cost for 40 GB is a derived calculation of $13.20/month (40 GB × $0.33/GB/mo). Because this derived amount is below the stated minimum, the final bill is the minimum charge of $50/month [1].

## Pricing Structure on the Standard Plan
- The official pricing page explicitly lists the Standard plan storage rate as **$0.33/GB/mo** [1].
- The exact row from the pricing table reads: "Storage | Up to 2 GB | Up to 10 GB | Unlimited $0.33/GB/mo | Unlimited $0.33/GB/mo", with the $0.33/GB/mo rate appearing in the Standard (and Enterprise) columns [1].
- The page states the minimum-commitment rule verbatim: "You'll be charged a minimum of $50/month. Once your usage exceeds this amount, you'll pay as you go." [1].

- The Standard plan includes features such as Dedicated Read Nodes, Import from object storage, Backup and Restore, RBAC, and SSO (SAML 2.0) [1].
- The page also shows related Standard-plan pricing dimensions, such as Write Units at "$4–$4.50 per million (varies by cloud and region)" [1].

## Cost Calculation for 40 GB
- Per-GB storage rate (from official page): **$0.33/GB/mo** [1].
- Minimum monthly charge (from official page): **$50/month** [1].
- Derived calculation (not a cited line item): 40 GB × $0.33/GB/mo = **$13.20/month**.
- Final bill = max($13.20, $50) = **$50/month**, since the computed usage cost ($13.20) is below the $50 minimum [1].
